description: Training week or month at a glance: sessions and volume per sport, time in the Garmin HR zones 1-5 (for the 3-zone Z1/Z2/Z3 split against LT1/LTHR, e.g. time below LT1 or polarisation, use get_load), active vs rest days, longest and hardest session, `garmin_load_model` at the end (CTL/ATL/TSB from Garmin's daily training load (EPOC); the own TSS model is get_load), and only avg/min/max of sleep, HRV, resting HR, steps, stress and body battery plus average daily kcal. Day-by-day values and other metrics (calorie totals, intensity minutes, floors, respiration, SpO2) come from query_health, weight from get_body_composition. Weeks run Monday-Sunday. Period "range" gives the same for any from..to up to 366 days, e.g. a training block: {"period":"range","from":"2026-08-04","to":"2026-09-28"}. `complete` is true when the period is over and all its data is in the cache; `training` is left out while its activities are not. Example: {"period":"week","anchor_date":"2026-10-08"}.

anchor_date.description: week/month: any date inside the period; default today

name: get_period_summary
title: Summarise a week, month or range
